railroad-beta
value = terminal("x");

railroad-ebnf-beta
expression = term, ( '+' term | '-' term )*;

railroad-ebnf-beta
value ::= [ '-' ], { digit };

railroad-ebnf-beta
value = prefix? digit+ suffix* ? implementation defined ?;

railroad-ebnf-beta
letter = alpha - 'x';

railroad-ebnf-beta
title 'Expression grammar'
accTitle: Grammar
accDescr {
  EBNF grammar
}
(* ISO comment *)
expression = term; %% trailing comment

railroad-abnf-beta
rule = other-rule "value" %x41;

railroad-abnf-beta
rule = prefix (ALPHA / DIGIT / "-");

railroad-abnf-beta
rule = [ "optional" ];

railroad-peg-beta
value <- identifier "literal" 'single';

railroad-peg-beta
expression <- term (("+" / "-") term)*;

railroad-peg-beta
any <- .;

railroad-beta
digit = terminal("0") ;
